title: 10 Best Nelumbo Nucifera Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Nelumbo nucifera are teas, decoctions, tinctures, mucillages, and oils, each offering unique therapeutic benefits. Teas made from the leaves or petals are commonly used to promote relaxation and digestive health. Decoctions involve simmering the roots or seeds to extract their potent compounds. Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb for quicker absorption. Mucillages, derived from the seeds, are used for their soothing and healing properties, while oils extracted from the seeds are applied topically for skin and wound care.
